safe_test_strategy: Compare restricted read responses for identities with different explicit privileges.
expected_behavior: Restricted content must remain inaccessible to identities without the required permission.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Restricted data returned to an identity lacking the documented permission.
impact: Disclosure of restricted functionality or data.
